correctness.rationale: For independent homogeneous bond retention on an undirected tree, expected outbreak size from root s including seed is M_s(p)=sum_v p^{d(s,v)}. Every pair difference has factors p(1-p). Source checker.py exhausts labelled n^(n-2) Prüfer trees n<=7 (16,807 labelled at n=7), canonical unlabelled trees 1,1,2,3,6,11, all unordered seed pairs and rational Sturm sequences; exactly three representative pairs at n=7 have an interior crossing, in two marked-pair isomorphism classes, none for n<=6. An independent NetworkX nonisomorphic-tree enumeration with SymPy exact interval root count (open endpoints explicitly excluded) reproduced 0 crossings n<=6 and 3 at n=7, witness factors (1-2p) and (1-p-p^2), so strict reversal at 1/2 and (sqrt(5)-1)/2. No general n>7 statement is inferred.
